title: The tears of a clown - SMOKEY ROBINSON

lines.l: Now honey, that's quite a different subject
Don't let my glad expression
Can't use the wrong impression
Really I'm sad
Sad, sad, sad
Sad, sad, sad
But you're gone and I'm hurting so bad
Like a cloud I pretend to be glad
Sad, sad, sad
Now there's some sad things known to men, but ain't too much sad a thing
The tears of a clown, when there's no one around
Oh yeah baby, now if I appear to be carefree
It's only to camouflage my sadness In order to shield my pride, I try to cover this hurt with a show of gladness
But don't let my show convince you That I've been happy since you decided to go
It's just what I need to sell
I've heard that I want you to know
But for others I've put on a show
It's just a show
I've got some sad things on a man
But ain't too much standing
The tears of a cloud
And there's no ruin around
Oh yeah
Just like Pagliacci did
I try to keep myself to see you
Smiling in the world, the guys will cry
But in my lonely room, I cry the tears
And there's no one around
Oh yeah, baby
Now listen to smile on my face
Don't let my bad expression
Can't prove the wrong impression
Don't let this smile out when
We made you think that I don't care
